name: Bern: Hirschengraben → Welle

alight.name: Bern, Hirschengraben
alight.note: Stop ID and coordinates are from the captured timetable response. Timing bounds the mapped stop quays; no independent railway minimum transfer time was established.

rideOn.name: Bern, Bahnhof
rideOn.note: Recorded tram 9 and bus 12 connections take one minute from Hirschengraben, then allocate six minutes from Bern Bahnhof to the railway station. Actual feeder times and pass-list identity govern use.

validity.note: Desk review expires at the December 2026 timetable change; this is a review deadline, not an announced closure.

fieldCheckNeeded: Walk each supported boarding-quay approach and confirm current signs, crossings and public entrance availability.
Measure actual stair rise; step counts are mapped, while 0.18 m per riser is an explicit conservative timing assumption.
Measure door approach by train length and stopping sector; current typical/maximum 120/350 m values are model allowances.
Time a representative peak-period transfer; short-notice closures and pedestrian queues are not available from the connection API.
Recheck Welle crowding and construction signs; tracks 1/2 and the future Bubenberg passage are deliberately unsupported.
instructions: From Hirschengraben, follow the public pavements north towards Schanzenstrasse and Welle. Use the marked crossings and obey signals. Enter the existing Welle passerelle, then take the signed stairs down to your platform. Stay on the public route shown by current signs.
